Classic thick flannel fabric, comfortable and versatile

Friendly Reminder:
1. The lamp is outfitted with a rechargeable lithium battery. Do not expose the battery to heat source or sunlight. Do not handle this product while connected to the power source.
2. The light must not in any case be modified or forced;every alteration may compromise safety and make it hazardous. Manufacturer declines any responsibility for altered products.
3. Do not immerse the product into water or handle it with wet hands.
4. The product should not be connected to the power source while being cleaned. The lamp should be cleaned with a soft damp cloth using altered neutral liquid detergent soap.
5. Avoid using alcohol or detergents containing acetone thiamine ammonia or any other solvent.
6. Ensure the optimal performance of the battery. We suggest it to be discharged and recharged completely for the first 10 cycles.
7. Charge the battery as soon as possible after it gets empty.
8. Use only the original rechargeable battery pack. Do not use under any circumstances regular batteries,because it can be dangerous.
9. Battery Removal
a) Make sure that the product is not connected to a power source.
b) Remove the bottom surface by loosening its screws;take the connector apart and remove the battery by ungluing it. Take the battery to a suitable processing center.
